limitations: Bounded evaluation over three Python 3.12.13 documentation files and 70 chunks; it does not represent all Python documentation and is NOT validation of Python documentation in general.
Retrieval metrics only. No generation and no faithfulness metrics are produced by this module; retrieval quality does not imply answer faithfulness.
No LLM is involved anywhere; generation is out of scope for this materializer.

The semantic model (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, revision 5c38ec7c) is used locally with local_files_only=True from a gitignored cache; weights are never committed or redistributed. No benchmark numbers from the model card are claimed as project metrics, and no model is claimed to be universally best.
Semantic float inference is deterministic within one CPU thread and one process; cross-process float determinism is best-effort. Ranking stability is recorded from two runs in the same process.
Denominators are small (12 answerable and 6 non-answerable queries per mode); one query moves percentages by up to 8.3 percentage points.

Only wall-clock seconds per mode and process-wide peak RSS are recorded; per-mode memory was not measured. Runtime observations and the timestamp are runtime provenance and are excluded from the deterministic digest.
No chunk-level or claim-level text is stored in this report; only chunk ids, query ids, and metric numbers.

model.acquisition_method: Hugging Face resolve URLs pinned to the exact revision 5c38ec7c405ec4b44b94cc5a9bb96e735b38267a (https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5/resolve/<revision>/<file>); no mutable branch, no mirror, no fallback

runtime_observations.memory_note: Only process-wide peak RSS is recorded; per-mode memory was not measured.
